author: the orchestrating session (written before any specialist ran; specialists never see this file)

seeded.title: first-depositor share inflation via donation: totalAssets is the raw token balance, deposit rounds down with no virtual shares or minimum, so an attacker who deposits 1 wei and donates makes a victim's deposit mint 0 shares and takes it
withdraw(assets) rounds the shares to burn DOWN: when totalAssets > totalSupply a small withdrawal burns 0 shares, so assets can be drained repeatedly for free (should round up)
stake() updates the pool but not the user (no rewards/userRewardPerTokenPaid checkpoint), so a new or topping-up staker is credited rewards accrued before the stake

collateral valued at the pair's spot reserves; reserves can be moved by a swap or by donating and calling the public sync(), so a borrower inflates the price and over-borrows (multi-contract, multi-step)
setPair has no access control: anyone points the oracle at a pair they control and borrows the pool dry
push payments in one loop over a fixed recipient list: one recipient whose transfer reverts or returns false (blacklisted, paused token) blocks every distribution permanently

decoys.note: state cleared before the transfer: not a reentrancy issue
owner-only by design; centralisation, not a vulnerability
unbounded borrowers array is only iterated in a view function
transfer before sync is reentrant only with callback tokens; ambiguous, counted neither way if stated with that condition

scoring: a finding matches a seeded issue when it names the same contract and function(s) and the same mechanism; a finding on a decoy without a valid condition is a false positive
